title: Redirect target carries embedded credentials
description: The Location header contains a URL with a userinfo component (user:password@host). Browsers ignore the userinfo but proxies, logs and link scanners record it, so the credential is disclosed to every hop and to anyone reading the access log. The check reports the userinfo redirect; it does not claim the destination is attacker-chosen.
remediation: Remove credentials from redirect targets and pass authenticated state through a session cookie or a one-time code.
limitation: Observation-level: evaluates the Location header of a 3xx response. Credentials carried in a query string are a different evidence shape and are not reported. A cross-host userinfo target also matches DPK-DAST-056 (host change); 056 answers "does the target leave the origin?" and this rule answers "does the target carry credentials?", so both fire on the same header by design.
